method: Technical alpha extraction of built-in generated hair only; original pet face/ears/body remain untouched.

entries.threshold: Warm brown: smooth r-g 4..12, g-b 1..7, max G225..242 B195..216; pink-ear exclusion (g-b)/(r-g) .20...31. Blue ties only sea-braid g-r-10..2, b-r1..8 and b-g0..5. 1.65 source px feather; capybara rear nape additionally follows an uneven scalp arc with a 19-source-px gradual fade (original RGB retained); alpha<5 removed; components<45 source px removed.
